nonNegotiables.title: 3 Non-Negotiables
nonNegotiables.subtitle: What are you absolutely not willing to compromise on?
nonNegotiables.instruction: Choose the 3 conditions a job must meet — miss even one and you'd turn it down, no matter how good the rest looks.
nonNegotiables.stepSelectHint: Select as many as you want first. Then we'll narrow it down.
nonNegotiables.stepNarrowHint: This is the hard part. Remove everything except your absolute deal-breakers.
nonNegotiables.stepRankHint: Drag to reorder. #1 = the one you'd never ever compromise on.
nonNegotiables.tooMany: You have {{count}} selected. Remove {{excess}} to continue.
nonNegotiables.completedHint: These are your career deal-breakers. Your coach and action plan will respect these.

flowMoments.title: Flow Moments
flowMoments.subtitle: When did you lose track of time?
flowMoments.instruction: Recall 3 moments when you were so absorbed in something that hours flew by. These moments reveal your natural talents.
flowMoments.descriptionPlaceholder: What were you doing? (e.g. debugging a tricky problem, designing a poster...)
flowMoments.socialLabel: Were you alone or with others?
flowMoments.completedHint: Your coach will use these patterns to identify your natural strengths.
flowMoments.noPattern: No strong pattern — your flow is diverse!
